wealthy.en: People in Britain were becoming wealthier and even more urban than they had been before.
wealthy.zh: 英国人变得比以前更富有，城市化程度也更高。

wealthy.en: French cuisine became really fashionable in Britain, among the wealthy classes anyway.
wealthy.zh: 法国菜在英国确实变得很时髦，无论如何是在富裕阶层中。

wealth.en: They were really expensive, so they were associated with wealth and status, but they were used generously .
wealth.zh: 它们真的很昂贵，因此它们与财富和地位联系在一起，但它们的使用毫不吝啬。
